page.layout: One page of text, single column; page number top right; no margin notes; a bracketed diagram block of conjugation forms in the middle; catchword/signature at foot "Sub-" and signature "I" at bottom.

main_text.p: Che tu fij stato amato, daß du geliebet gewest seyst.
Che colui fij stato amato, daß er geliebet gewest sey. Ille amatus sit, vel fuerit.
Daß wir, jhr, sie geliebt gewesen seyd, seyn: Nos amati simus, vel fuerimus. Vos amati sitis, vel fueritis. Illi amati sint, vel fuerint.
main_text.head: Praeterit. Plusq. perfect.
main_text.p: O Dio volesse che io fossi, che tu fossi, che colui fosse stato amato. Daß ich, du, er wäre, wärest geliebt gewesen.

p.i: Vtinam ego amatus essem, vel fuissem, tu amatus esses, ille amatus esset.

main_text.p: Daß wir, jhr, sie wåren, wåret geliebt gewefen.

page.notes: Brace-bracketed conjugation diagrams; the Greek-free Italian and German mix transcribed as printed. Page-number and "Sub-" catchword at foot-right are partly cut off.
